options: Red is likely because there are more red counters.

options: Red must appear exactly 5 times.
Blue cannot appear twice.

options: Only after every other name is picked.

options: Both groups must have 6 heads.

options: Neither side can appear next.
Heads or tails could appear.
Tails must appear next.
Heads must appear next.

options: 4 heads and 6 tails
5 heads and 5 tails
3 heads and 7 tails

Returning a counter stops results from varying.
Chance results can vary between groups.

options: The next spin must be blue.
Red appeared more, but this was not guaranteed.
Red must appear more in every future group.
Blue is now impossible.

options: The counts may be the same or different.
They must get exactly the same counts.
They must get exactly 10 of each side.
The side with fewer results must win next time.
pretest.prompt: What should they expect when they repeat the experiment?
